character_reference: a tall, lean man with messy dark hair, wearing a worn charcoal-grey tactical jacket with glowing amber circuitry patterns running down his sleeves
story_so_far: After surviving Commander Vance's ambush and fighting Marcus in a subterranean facility, Kael reached an abandoned orbital platform. Triggering a security trap, he discovered a live countdown timer pointing at the metropolis below and must now escape before the station crashes.
